West Drive Executive is a premium chauffeur and luxury vehicle business based in Birmingham, serving clients across the UK.

We are looking for a business development / partnerships specialist who can help us win high-value recurring clients and referral partners.

This is not a generic lead generation role and we are not interested in someone simply sending thousands of cold emails.

Our objective is to build relationships with organisations and individuals capable of generating significant recurring bookings.

Target Clients / Partners

We are particularly interested in developing relationships with:

Executive Assistants / Personal Assistants to HNW and UHNW individuals

Corporate travel managers

Family offices

Private aviation companies, FBOs and jet brokers

Luxury hotels and concierge teams

Luxury travel advisors and DMCs

Wealth management / private banking firms

Law firms, accountancy firms and professional services businesses

Event agencies

Celebrity / VIP management companies

Production companies

Luxury concierge businesses

Companies requiring executive transport for directors, clients and events

The goal is to win recurring corporate accounts, preferred-supplier relationships and referral partnerships, rather than one-off low-value bookings.

What We Need You To Do

Initially, we would expect you to:

Identify and research high-value target accounts.

Find the correct decision-makers within those organisations.

Build highly targeted prospect lists.

Develop outreach messaging tailored to each audience.

Carry out personalised outreach through email and/or LinkedIn.

Follow up professionally with prospects.

Generate qualified conversations and meetings.

Track prospects and opportunities in a simple CRM.

Help develop partnership propositions for hotels, aviation, concierge and corporate clients.

Work with us to turn initial bookings into recurring accounts.

We can personally handle important sales calls and meetings if necessary, so we are open to candidates who are particularly strong at identifying prospects and creating qualified opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

We are not interested in vanity metrics such as:

number of emails sent

email open rates

large unqualified lead lists

We care about:

conversations with genuine decision-makers

qualified meetings

trial bookings

corporate accounts opened

preferred-supplier relationships

recurring bookings

revenue generated from accounts you originate

Our longer-term aim is to develop relationships capable of generating £5,000–£20,000+ per month in chauffeur and executive transport revenue.

We understand that high-value relationships take time to develop and do not expect unrealistic overnight results.

Who We Are Looking For

We would particularly like to hear from people with experience in one or more of:

Luxury hospitality

Private aviation

Corporate travel

Executive transport

Luxury concierge

UHNW / private-client services

Family offices

Business development

B2B outbound sales

Strategic partnerships

Professional services

Events / VIP hospitality

Existing relationships within these industries would be a major advantage.

UK market experience is strongly preferred.

Budget / Working Arrangement

We are currently looking for a cost-effective freelancer rather than an expensive agency or £2,000+ per month consultant.

We are open to:

hourly arrangements

a small monthly commitment

project-based trials

base payment + performance commission

For the right candidate, we would be very happy to pay additional commission for genuinely valuable accounts that result in revenue.

We would prefer to begin with a small paid trial before committing long term.

When Applying

Please answer the following rather than sending a generic proposal:

1. Give one example of a high-value corporate or partnership client you personally helped win. What did you actually do?

2. Have you worked with luxury clients, executive assistants, corporate travel, private aviation, hotels, concierge businesses, family offices or similar audiences?

3. If you had 30 days to generate the first serious corporate opportunity for West Drive Executive, who would you target first and why?

4. How would you find and approach those decision-makers?

5. What would you personally do each week?

6. How would you measure your success?

7. Are you open to a small initial paid trial plus commission for accounts that generate revenue?

Please do not apply if your strategy is simply mass cold email or providing large generic lead lists.

We are looking for someone who understands that one excellent corporate or luxury relationship can be worth more than hundreds of ordinary enquiries.

title: Mobile App Developer (FlutterFlow + Supabase) - South Wales
proj_desc:
I am looking for an experienced mobile app developer to build a field lookup and grading tool from scratch for my catalytic converter recycling business, Crucible Exchange Ltd.

The app will be used on-site in the yard to quickly look up codes from a catalogue of ~14,500 items, factor in live PGM market movements, apply a custom margin fee structure, and calculate net buy prices on the spot.

Key Scope & Requirements:

Database & Scale (Supabase): Set up a PostgreSQL database handling ~14,500 catalog rows with image storage, optimized full-text search indexing across both primary and extra codes plus manufacturers, and proper Row Level Security (RLS).

Mobile Layout Architecture (FlutterFlow): Build a mobile-first ListView using custom Cards (Thumbnail Image, Primary Code, Extra Code, Manufacturer, Description) designed for fast, one-handed scanning on smartphones.

Search & Pagination: Implement server-side filtering and infinite-scroll pagination so 14.5k rows load instantaneously without lagging.

Pricing & Margin Engine: Integrate calculation logic that applies a percentage fee/margin structure against base PGM values or fixed pricing data.

Condition Grading Modifiers: Include quick-select buttons on the pricing view (Full Core - 100%, Partial/Damaged - %, Empty - 0%) that dynamically adjust the calculated buy price on the fly.

Batch Tally / Basket Feature: Allow users to tap "Add to Batch" on multiple converters to build a running total payout list for multi-unit purchases with an itemized summary output.

In-Person Kickoff: Must be based in or near South Wales (Cardiff, Newport, Swansea, Hengoed, or surrounding M4 area) for an initial in-person meeting to go over the physical dataset and valuation workflow. 
etc...

Deliverables:
Fully working mobile app built directly inside my existing FlutterFlow and Supabase accounts with 100% IP/source handover.

Budget:
Fixed Price: £1,000 (Split across 3 Escrow Milestones)

title: The Black Reserve Collectibles — Premium Brand Identity Design
proj_desc:
The Black Reserve Collectibles — Premium Brand Identity Design

Project Overview

I am seeking an experienced designer to develop the core brand identity for The Black Reserve Collectibles, an emerging premium trading-card and collectibles business initially focused on Pokémon cards, graded cards and sealed products.

This is a complete brand identity commission, not simply a logo design. The objective is to create a distinctive, professional and commercially practical identity that can grow with the business.

The work will be commissioned in separate phases, with Phase One being the only current commission.

Brand Vision and Creative Direction

The Black Reserve Collectibles should feel like a premium collector’s house: sophisticated, discreet, trustworthy and connected to collector culture.

The visual identity should be understated, luxurious and recognisable without looking like a generic gaming shop or esports brand.

Colour palette:

* Deep black.
* Ivory.
* Restrained burnt-orange or copper accents.

Required identity elements:

* Distinctive BR monogram.
* Primary wordmark: THE BLACK RESERVE COLLECTIBLES.
* Secondary or compact logo.
* Light and dark variations.
* Clean typography and consistent visual styling.

Avoid cartoon mascots, neon gaming aesthetics, generic templates, excessive gradients and unnecessary decorative elements.

The identity must be scalable, legible and suitable for digital and print applications.

Phase One — Core Brand Identity

Please quote for the following deliverables:

1. Primary logo and wordmark.
2. BR monogram.
3. Secondary logo variation.
4. Light, dark, full-colour and monochrome versions.
5. Brand colour palette with colour codes.
6. Typography recommendations.
7. Concise brand guidelines covering logo usage, colours and typography.
8. High-resolution transparent PNG files.
9. Editable vector files, including SVG and print-ready PDF.
10. Organised editable source files.
11. Confirmation of commercial usage rights, licensing and ownership.

Please specify the number of initial concepts, revision rounds, turnaround time and any additional charges.

The project should follow clear approval stages: initial concepts, selection of a preferred direction, refinement, final approval and file handover.

Phase One exclusions: Website development, social media templates, packaging artwork, product graphics, printing, photography and ongoing design support are not included unless separately agreed.

Phase Two — Digital and Retail Applications

Once Phase One is approved, potential future work may include:

* Social media graphics, banners and templates.
* Product listing and promotional graphics.
* Product photography layouts.
* Packaging stickers and labels.
* Thank-you cards, inserts and stationery.

Phase Two will have its own scope, quotation and timeline. There is no obligation to proceed.

Practical Requirements

The identity must work across e-commerce, online marketplaces, social media, product listings, packaging and future retail applications.

It should be practical to reproduce, easy to maintain and flexible enough to support additional collectible categories in the future.

I am looking for a designer with experience in premium branding, logo systems, monogram design, retail identity and digital applications. Original thinking, attention to detail and clear communication are important.

Budget and Quotation

My initial target budget is £100–£200 for Phase One, depending on the proposed scope and quality of work.

Please provide a fixed-price quotation specifying:

* Included deliverables and exclusions.
* Number of concepts and revisions.
* Timeline and approval process.
* Final file formats and editable source files.
* Commercial usage rights and ownership.
* Any additional licensing or third-party costs.

Indicative pricing for Phase Two is welcome but should be quoted separately.

How to Apply

Please include a portfolio link, examples of relevant branding projects, your proposed approach, fixed-price quotation, revision allowance and estimated timeline.

I am looking to establish a professional, distinctive and long-term brand identity, rather than purchase a disposable logo. I welcome proposals from designers who understand both premium brand development and practical commercial design.

I need a custom plugin written to integrate the Sngine php social network with Patreon to sync active patreon tiers.

 Sngine - https://codecanyon.net/item/sngine-the-ultimate-social-network-platform/13526001
Patreon API - https://docs.patreon.com/#introduction

I have a page on patreon where members can buy either monthly, yearly or lifetime subscriptions. On my social network (Sngine) I have three PRO packages available with the same options. Basically I need to check the Patreon API via the OAuth2 and Webhooks system to link the user and check they have an active subscription and link them to the correct PRO package on Sngine. I need the webhook to make sure the subscription is still active or if it has been deleted. 

This link (AI query) I made on google has suggested how this might be built and explains further:
https://www.google.com/search?q=integrate+sngine+php+social+network+with+patreon+sync+active+patreon+tier&rlz=1C1ONGR_en-GBGB967GB967&oq=integrate+sngine+php+social+network+with+patreon+sync+active+patreon+tier&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQIRiPAjIHCAIQIRiPAtIBCjMxNDIxajBqMTWoAgiwAgE&sourceid=chrome&source=chrome.rb&ie=UTF-8

Please let me know if you have further questions.

title: Masonic Toast Writer Required
proj_desc:
I'm looking for an experienced writer to assist with preparing short Masonic toasts, responses, and occasional speeches throughout the year.
Requirements:
Excellent English writing skills.
Ability to write in a traditional, respectful, and occasionally humorous style.
Understanding of Masonic customs, etiquette, and dining traditions would be advantageous, although not essential.
Ability to capture key information and turn it into a polished toast or response.
Quick turnaround for shorter pieces of work.
Typical Work:
Festival and Ladies' Night toasts.
Responses to toasts.
Installation and officer-related speeches.
Short presentations and introductions.
Occasional bespoke Masonic writing projects.
Most assignments will be relatively short (typically a few hundred words), though there may be occasional larger projects.
I'm looking to establish an ongoing relationship with a reliable writer for ad hoc assignments throughout the year.
